section.content: 本实用新型涉及文本处理终端技术领域，且公开了一种基于人工智能机器学习的文本处理终端，包括壳体，壳体的后侧壁设有后盖板，后盖板的前侧壁固定连接有承载板，壳体的下侧壁内部开设有控制腔，控制腔的左侧壁通过轴承转动连接有表面螺纹相反的螺纹杆，螺纹杆外螺纹套设有两个螺纹筒，两个螺纹筒的上侧壁均固定连接有导向板，控制腔的上侧壁开设有与导向板相互匹配的导向口，导向板伸出导向口的侧壁固定连接有限位销。本实用新型能够在对终端内部电子元件进行维修，在不需要使用其他工具的情况下即可便捷快速的将电子元件从设备内取出，不需要操作人员在设备内部对电子元件进行拆装，提高了操作人员的工作效率。

The utility model relates to the technical field of text processing terminals and discloses a text processing terminal based on artificial intelligence machine learning, which comprises a shell, wherein a rear cover plate is arranged on the rear side wall of the shell, a bearing plate is fixedly connected to the front side wall of the rear cover plate, a control cavity is formed in the lower side wall of the shell, the left side wall of the control cavity is rotatably connected with a threaded rod with opposite surface threads through a bearing, two threaded cylinders are sleeved on the outer threads of the threaded rod, guide plates are fixedly connected to the upper side walls of the two threaded cylinders, guide openings matched with the guide plates are formed in the upper side walls of the control cavity, and limit pins are fixedly connected to the side walls of the guide plates, extending out of the guide openings. The utility model can maintain the electronic element in the terminal, can conveniently and quickly take out the electronic element from the equipment without using other tools, does not need an operator to disassemble and assemble the electronic element in the equipment, and improves the working efficiency of the operator.

Text processing terminal based on artificial intelligence machine learningTechnical Field

The utility model relates to the technical field of text processing terminals, in particular to a text processing terminal based on artificial intelligence machine learning.

Background

A Terminal (Terminal) is also called a Terminal device, and is a device located at the outermost periphery of a network in a computer network, and is mainly used for inputting user information and outputting a processing result. In early computer systems, since the host computer was expensive, one host computer (IBM mainframe computer) was generally configured with a plurality of terminals, which had no computing power and only assumed the work of inputting and outputting information, and the operation and processing were performed by the host computer. In the age of personal computers, personal computers may run programs called terminal emulators to emulate the operation of a terminal.

The text processing terminal of current artificial intelligence machine learning when using, the inside at terminal can be equipped with a large amount of electronic component, when the electronic component in terminal inside appears damaging, needs operating personnel use tools to take out the circuit board with screw dismantlement in terminal inside and change electronic component, and it is very inconvenient at the inside use tools of terminal, influences operating personnel's work efficiency.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

The utility model aims to solve the problems that in the prior art, when a text processing terminal for artificial intelligence machine learning is used, a large number of electronic elements are arranged inside the terminal, when the electronic elements inside the terminal are damaged, an operator needs to use a tool to disassemble screws inside the terminal and take out the circuit board to replace the electronic elements, the tool is extremely inconvenient to use inside the terminal, and the working efficiency of the operator is affected, and provides the text processing terminal based on artificial intelligence machine learning.

In order to achieve the purpose, the utility model adopts the following technical scheme:

a text processing terminal based on artificial intelligence machine learning comprises a shell, wherein a rear cover plate is arranged on the rear side wall of the shell, a bearing plate is fixedly connected to the front side wall of the rear cover plate, a control cavity is formed in the lower side wall of the shell, the left side wall of the control cavity is rotatably connected with a threaded rod with opposite surface threads through a bearing, two threaded cylinders are sleeved on the outer threaded sleeve of the threaded rod, guide plates are fixedly connected to the upper side walls of the two threaded cylinders, guide ports matched with the guide plates are formed in the upper side wall of the control cavity, limit pins are fixedly connected to the side walls of the guide plates extending out of the guide ports, two limit plates are symmetrically and fixedly connected to the lower side wall of the bearing plate, limit holes matched with the limit pins are formed in the side walls of the limit plates, a rotary hole is formed in the right side wall of the control cavity, a rotary rod is rotatably connected in the rotary hole through a bearing, and a positioning mechanism is arranged outside one end of the rotating rod extending out of the rotating hole.

Preferably, the positioning mechanism comprises a rotary drum sleeved outside the rotary rod, the right end of the rotary rod is provided with a spring groove, a side wall between the spring groove and the rotary drum is fixedly connected with a same spring, the inner wall of the rotary drum is fixedly connected with a sliding plate, the rod wall of the rotary rod is provided with a sliding groove matched with the sliding plate, the left side wall of the rotary drum is provided with a plurality of clamping grooves, and the right side wall of the shell is fixedly connected with two clamping pins matched with the clamping grooves.

Preferably, the lateral walls of the left side and the right side of the shell are fixedly connected with fans, and the lateral walls of the left side and the right side of the shell are provided with radiating holes and dustproof nets inserted in the radiating holes.

Preferably, the lower side wall of the threaded cylinder is fixedly connected with a sliding plate, and the lower side wall of the control cavity is provided with a sliding groove matched with the sliding plate.

Preferably, the four corners of the lower side wall of the bearing plate are fixedly connected with bearing wheels.

Preferably, the front side wall of the rear cover plate is fixedly connected with a rubber ring, and the rear side wall of the shell is provided with a sealing groove matched with the rubber ring.

Compared with the prior art, the utility model provides a text processing terminal based on artificial intelligence machine learning, which has the following beneficial effects:

this text processing terminal based on artificial intelligence machine learning, through the casing that sets up, the back shroud, the loading board, the control chamber, the threaded rod, a screw thread section of thick bamboo, the deflector, the direction mouth, the spacer pin, the limiting plate, spacing hole, change the hole, the bull stick, positioning mechanism, can maintain the inside electronic component in terminal, can be convenient quick under the condition that need not use other instruments take out electronic component from the equipment in, do not need operating personnel to carry out the dismouting to electronic component in equipment inside, operating personnel's work efficiency has been improved.

The electronic elements in the terminal can be maintained, the electronic elements can be taken out from the equipment conveniently and quickly without using other tools, and an operator does not need to disassemble and assemble the electronic elements in the equipment, so that the working efficiency of the operator is improved.

In the figure: the device comprises a shell 1, a rear cover plate 2, a bearing plate 3, a control cavity 4, a threaded rod 5, a threaded cylinder 6, a guide plate 7, a guide port 8, a limit pin 9, a limit plate 10, a limit hole 11, a rotary hole 12, a rotary rod 13, a positioning mechanism 14, a rotary cylinder 15, a spring groove 16, a spring 17, a sliding plate 18, a sliding groove 19, a clamping groove 20, a clamping pin 21, a fan 22, a dust screen 23, a sliding plate 24, a sliding groove 25, a bearing wheel 26 and a rubber ring 27.

Detailed Description

The technical solutions in the embodiments of the present invention will be clearly and completely described below with reference to the drawings in the embodiments of the present invention, and it is obvious that the described embodiments are only a part of the embodiments of the present invention, and not all of the embodiments.

In the description of the present invention, it is to be understood that the terms "upper", "lower", "front", "rear", "left", "right", "top", "bottom", "inner", "outer", and the like, indicate orientations or positional relationships based on the orientations or positional relationships shown in the drawings, are merely for convenience in describing the present invention and simplifying the description, and do not indicate or imply that the device or element being referred to must have a particular orientation, be constructed and operated in a particular orientation, and thus, should not be construed as limiting the present invention.

Referring to fig. 1-4, a text processing terminal based on artificial intelligence machine learning, comprising a housing 1, a back cover plate 2 is arranged on the back side wall of the housing 1, a bearing plate 3 is fixedly connected on the front side wall of the back cover plate 2, a control chamber 4 is arranged in the lower side wall of the housing 1, a threaded rod 5 with opposite surface threads is rotatably connected on the left side wall of the control chamber 4 through a bearing, two threaded cylinders 6 are sleeved on the outer thread of the threaded rod 5, a guide plate 7 is fixedly connected on the upper side walls of the two threaded cylinders 6, a guide port 8 matched with the guide plate 7 is arranged on the upper side wall of the control chamber 4, a limit pin 9 is fixedly connected on the side wall of the guide plate 7 extending out of the guide port 8, two limit plates 10 are symmetrically and fixedly connected on the lower side wall of the bearing plate 3, a limit hole 11 matched with the limit pin 9 is arranged on the side wall of the limit plate 10, a rotary hole 12 is arranged on the right side wall of the control chamber 4, a rotating rod 13 is rotatably connected in the rotating hole 12 through a bearing, and a positioning mechanism 14 is arranged outside one end of the rotating rod 13, which extends out of the rotating hole 12.

Positioning mechanism 14 establishes rotary drum 15 outside bull stick 13 including the cover, spring groove 16 has been seted up to the right-hand member of bull stick 13, the same root spring 17 of lateral wall fixedly connected with between spring groove 16 and the rotary drum 15, the inner wall fixedly connected with sliding plate 18 of rotary drum 15, sliding tray 19 with sliding plate 18 mutual matching has been seted up to the pole wall of bull stick 13, a plurality of draw-in grooves 20 have been seted up to the left side wall of rotary drum 15, two bayonet locks 21 that match each other with draw-in groove 20 of the right side wall fixedly connected with of casing 1, can fix bull stick 13, increase the device's stability.

The equal fixedly connected with fan 22 of the lateral wall of casing 1 left and right sides, the lateral wall of casing 1 left and right sides has all been seted up the thermovent and has been pegged graft in the thermovent and have been had dust screen 23, has improved the device's heat-sinking capability.

The lower side wall fixedly connected with slide 24 of a screw thread section of thick bamboo 6, the lower side wall of control chamber 4 is offered the spout 25 that matches each other with slide 24, through the mutually supporting of slide 24 and spout 25, avoids a screw thread section of thick bamboo 6 rotatory, makes a screw thread section of thick bamboo 6 only can remove about the horizontal direction, has reduced the wearing and tearing between deflector 7 and the guide way 8.

The equal fixedly connected with bearing wheel 26 in the lower side wall four corners department of loading board 3 has improved the stability that loading board 3 removed.

The preceding lateral wall fixedly connected with rubber circle 27 of back shroud 2, the seal groove of mutually matchd with rubber circle 27 is seted up to the back lateral wall of casing 1, avoids impurity to get into casing 1.

In the utility model, when the device is used, the rotary drum 15 is pulled to a proper position in the direction away from the shell 1, then the rotary drum 15 is rotated, the rotary rod 13 and the threaded rod 5 are driven to rotate by the mutual matching of the sliding plate 18 and the sliding groove 19, the two threaded cylinders 6 are driven to move to proper positions in the direction close to each other by the thread matching, the threaded cylinders 6 drive the limiting pins 9 to be separated from the limiting holes 11 through the guide plates 7, the rear cover plate 2 and the bearing plate 3 can be taken down, the rear cover plate 2 and the bearing plate 3 can be installed and completed by reverse operation, electronic elements in the terminal can be maintained, the electronic elements can be taken out from the device conveniently and quickly without using other tools, an operator does not need to disassemble and assemble the electronic elements in the device, and the working efficiency of the operator is improved.

The above description is only for the preferred embodiment of the present invention, but the scope of the present invention is not limited thereto, and any person skilled in the art should be considered to be within the technical scope of the present invention, and equivalent alternatives or modifications according to the technical solution of the present invention and the inventive concept thereof should be covered by the scope of the present invention.
